lines.zh: 我走过的墙，眼睛都转过来。
lines.en: The eyes in the walls turn as I pass.

lines.zh: 我移动时，很多眼睛一起动。
lines.en: When I move, many eyes move too.
Eyes open one by one in the wall.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，为了让它们看清。
lines.en: I walk slowly so they all see.

lines.zh: 巨响过后，墙上多了眼睛。
lines.en: After the bang, more eyes appear on the wall.

lines.zh: 每走一步，就多一双眼睛。
lines.en: Each step adds another pair.

lines.zh: 脚步响一次，眼睛眨一次。
lines.en: A step, a blink.
The wall breathes as I near.

lines.zh: 我在走廊里走，四面都看着。
lines.en: I walk the hall; all sides watch.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，让你转不过来。
lines.en: I circle so you cannot turn fast enough.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很轻，眼睛很重。
lines.en: My steps are light. The gaze is heavy.

lines.zh: 我退到墙里，眼睛留在外面。
lines.en: I sink into the wall; the eyes remain.

lines.zh: 我停下，所有眼睛都睁开。
lines.en: I stop, and every eye opens.
The wall is all eyes, unblinking.

lines.zh: 你看向哪里，那里就有眼。
lines.en: Where you look, eyes appear.
I do not blink. Neither do they.
The walls of this room are alive.
I count how often you look.
The whites of them shine in the dark.
I stay still; the eyes keep turning.

lines.zh: 墙上的每一只眼都认得你。
lines.en: Every eye on this wall knows you.

lines.zh: 你背靠墙，就靠在我身上。
lines.en: Lean on the wall. You lean on me.
I wait for you to lose count.
More eyes here than bricks.

lines.zh: 你站在屋子中间，四面都是我们。
lines.en: Stand in the middle. We are on all four sides.
I do not blink, so the whites stay still.
Hundreds of gazes on you.

lines.zh: 你也长一双眼睛，回看我。
lines.en: You have eyes too. Use them.
Do not just watch me. Watch the walls.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，整间屋子都亮了。
lines.en: I open up and the whole room lights.
You turn too slowly to keep up.
Every one of them is on you.

lines.zh: 你要找的那只眼，在你后面。
lines.en: The one you want is behind you.

lines.zh: 你数得出这里有多少眼吗？
lines.en: Can you count them all?

lines.zh: 你抬起手，几百只眼跟着动。
lines.en: Raise a hand; hundreds follow it.

lines.zh: 别盯着其中一只看太久。
lines.en: Do not fix on just one too long.
I have no face. Only eyes.
You are already among us.
When I close, the room goes dark.

lines.zh: 你的每一个动作都被记下。
lines.en: Every move of yours is recorded.

lines.zh: 我眨眼的时候，会有一声巨响。
lines.en: When I blink, there is a loud crack.

lines.zh: 墙上的眼都在往中间聚。
lines.en: The eyes all gather toward the middle.
Your shadow has been seen through.
Where had you got to in the count?
Do not shut your eyes. More appear.
No windows here. Only eyes.
A few eyes shut.

lines.zh: 你打碎了一面墙，还有三面。
lines.en: One wall down. Three remain.
Something leaks from the wall.

lines.zh: 你打中的那只眼，正是我。
lines.en: The eye you struck was mine.
Every eye hates you at once.

lines.zh: 我退进墙里，露出一条缝。
lines.en: I sink in, leaving a seam.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记在每只眼里。
lines.en: Each eye records that blow.
The wall shakes. Pain or laughter?
You broke my gaze.
Hundreds of my eyes stay open.
You look at me. I look at you.
Set the food down. No eye blinks.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，所有眼都抬了。
lines.en: You lift it; every eye lifts too.
I do not eat. I need only to look.

lines.zh: 你举得太久，手会挡视线。
lines.en: Hold it longer and it blocks the view.

lines.zh: 这点东西收买不了眼睛。
lines.en: That will not buy a single eye.

lines.zh: 你把灯举起来，眼睛会疼。
lines.en: Lift that lamp. The eyes will ache.
Put it down. We are all watching.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，眼都看见了。
lines.en: Your hand shakes. Every eye saw.

lines.zh: 别往缝里塞东西，会被吃掉。
lines.en: Do not push it into a crack. It gets eaten.
You hit the wall, and the wall looks back.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，眼睛全转向你。
lines.en: I turn and all eyes swing to you.
The walls press inward.
You pull back; the eyes follow.

lines.zh: 碰撞让墙上的眼眨了一下。
lines.en: The bump made every eye blink.
Do not brush the wall. It remembers.

lines.zh: 你推我，墙就多张开一只眼。
lines.en: You shove me; another eye opens.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，但几百只眼看得见。
lines.en: I cannot see you. They can.
The wall is softer than you think.

lines.zh: 你撞上来时，我笑了没出声。
lines.en: When you hit me, I laughed silently.
Eyes do not breed. They open.
You cannot even find one face.

lines.zh: 这问题，几百只眼都听见了。
lines.en: Hundreds of eyes heard that.
We form no families.

lines.zh: 墙上的眼睛越来越多，够了。
lines.en: Enough eyes on this wall already.
Your curiosity is dangerous.
The answer is inside the wall.
We only watch. We never touch.

lines.zh: 你问一次，就多一双眼睛。
lines.en: One question, one more pair.
Stop. They have all memorized it.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉了，所有眼都看见。
lines.en: You dropped it. Every eye saw.
I do not pick it up. I watch it roll.

lines.zh: 墙上伸出一只手，把它拿了。
lines.en: A hand from the wall takes it.

lines.zh: 你弯腰时，四面八方都看着。
lines.en: When you bend, all sides watch.
That belongs to the wall now.

lines.zh: 捡起来，你会看见更多眼睛。
lines.en: Pick it up and you will see more eyes.
The eyes follow it to the floor.

lines.zh: 别低头，一低头就多一双。
lines.en: Do not look down. One more pair.
It is in the crack. Reach in.
We collect nothing. We only watch.
Every eye opened at once.
Did you hear that loud crack?
I begin the hunt.
The wall turns to face you.
Hundreds of gazes lock on you.

lines.zh: 你的位置被看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your position is very clear.
This time I do more than watch.

lines.zh: 眼睛挤在一起，挤满了墙。
lines.en: The eyes crowd until the wall is full.
There are eyes behind you now.
I want one last look at you.
Hear that inside the wall?
Every eye here answers to me.
Each turn costs you a path.
From now on, do not blink.
The eyes will tell you where I am.
Look closely. This is the last time.
The eyes on the wall start turning.

lines.zh: 你退一步，两边就多一双。
lines.en: A step back, a pair on each side.
I sit in your blind spot.
You cannot count them all. I know.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的眼越来越多。
lines.en: More eyes appear in this room.
Your knees have started to tremble.

lines.zh: 每一只眼都跟着你的手。
lines.en: Every eye follows your hand.
I blink and the wall cracks.

lines.zh: 你转到哪面墙，都是眼睛。
lines.en: Whatever wall you face is eyes.

lines.zh: 这里没有死角，只有眼睛。
lines.en: No blind spots. Only eyes.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸已经有节奏了。
lines.en: Your breathing has a rhythm now.

lines.zh: 我等着你眼睛酸的时候。
lines.en: I wait for your eyes to ache.

lines.zh: 墙在往里靠，你感觉得到。
lines.en: The walls close in. You feel it.
One more turn and only I remain.
Behind you the eyes are thickest.
Do not cover your eyes. It will not work.

lines.zh: 墙上的眼睛，一张张转过来。
lines.en: The eyes in the walls turn one by one.

lines.zh: 所有眼睛都朝一个方向转。
lines.en: All eyes turn one way.

lines.zh: 你回头时，我就在你后面。
lines.en: When you turn, I am right behind you.
That crack was meant for you.
The wall puts out countless hands.
One eye blinks and you are hurt.
The whole room presses down.
I look, and you bleed.
Claw marks open on your shoulder.
I open my mouth behind you.
That came from all directions.

lines.zh: 你躲开一只，还有许多只。
lines.en: Dodge one. There are many.
Your blood spattered the wall.
That was not a hand. A gaze.
You are shoved into the mass of eyes.
I close and you are caught.
Between these walls, it is narrow.
The crack put out every lamp.

lines.zh: 你倒地时，所有眼都低下来。
lines.en: As you fall, all eyes lower.
I am not done looking.

lines.zh: 墙面一阵响，眼睛张开了。
lines.en: The wall rattles and the eyes open.

lines.zh: 你听见一声巨响，就是我。
lines.en: That loud crack was me.

lines.zh: 整间屋子的墙开始眨眼。
lines.en: Every wall in the room blinks.
The first eye opens in the corner.

lines.zh: 你背后的墙上多了一张脸。
lines.en: A face joins the wall behind you.
You avoid the wall. It watches anyway.
Every eye in the building wakes.
The blood is wet, and the eyes arrive.

lines.zh: 墙上先是裂纹，然后是眼。
lines.en: First cracks, then eyes.

lines.zh: 所有光都被几百只眼吸走了。
lines.en: Hundreds of eyes drink the light.
I am here. Everywhere.

lines.zh: 你的墙有几只眼没数过？
lines.en: How many eyes did you miss?

lines.zh: 屋子安静下来，眼睛全开。
lines.en: The room falls quiet. All eyes open.
From floor one to three, all eyes.
Something inhales inside the wall.

lines.zh: 我睁开第一只眼，你就来了。
lines.en: I opened one eye and you arrived.
The wall bulges outward.

lines.zh: 你走进来的时候，我们就在。
lines.en: We were here before you entered.

lines.zh: 这间屋子从没这么亮过。
lines.en: This room has never been so lit.
Start counting.

lines.zh: 火光里，眼睛全眯起来了。
lines.en: In the fire's glare, every eye narrows.

lines.zh: 整面墙塌下来，眼还睁着。
lines.en: The wall collapses, eyes still open.

lines.zh: 水漫过墙面，眼睛在水下看。
lines.en: Water covers the wall; the eyes watch below.

lines.zh: 炸开的墙飞满整间屋子。
lines.en: The blasted wall fills the room.

lines.zh: 箭扎进一只眼，那一只瞎了。
lines.en: An arrow blinds one of them.
A spell shuts every eye.
Nothing to look at, and I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光把每只眼都照亮了。
lines.en: Lightning lights every eye at once.

lines.zh: 墙后是虚空，眼睛往里掉。
lines.en: Beyond the wall is void. The eyes fall in.
